jobs.description: Would you like to build technology products that help shape Amazon’s transition toward a more circular economy? Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) regulations are rapidly changing how producers and retailers manage products and packaging after sale, including recycling obligations, fees, reporting, seller compliance, and reverse logistics. Amazon is building the technology and operating mechanisms required to manage these obligations at global scale while creating the foundation for broader circularity services. As a Principal Product Manager – Technical, you will define and lead the product strategy for some of Amazon’s most complex sustainability and regulatory challenges. You will work across engineering, science, compliance, finance, operations, and sustainability teams to automate global EPR programs, improve product and packaging data, enable compliant selling partners, and develop scalable capabilities for recycling, recovery, and circularity. This role requires a product leader who can operate in significant ambiguity, translate evolving regulatory and business requirements into durable technical solutions, and influence across a broad set of senior stakeholders. You will help determine where Amazon should build common global platforms versus localized solutions, establish mechanisms that improve accuracy and reduce manual effort, and shape new services that can support both compliance and circular-economy objectives. This is a high-visibility opportunity to build at the intersection of technology, regulation, sustainability, and Amazon-scale commerce, with the ability to influence how Amazon manages producer responsibility today and how it develops broader circularity capabilities for the future. Key job responsibilities -Define and deliver AI-enabled products that scale global EPR compliance, including monitoring emerging regulations and policy changes, translating requirements into product and control strategies, and enabling rapid expansion across new geographies and regulatory use cases. -Improve the Selling Partner compliance experience by building products that make requirements easier to understand and act on, reduce the effort and cost required to achieve compliance, and enable sellers to continue offering products across Amazon stores. Own the multi-year product strategy and roadmap for EPR and circular economy, leading 3-Year Vision, annual operating planning, and quarterly prioritization while aligning investments across business, technology, compliance, sustainability, and operations teams. -Drive automation and simplification across Amazon’s EPR operating model, replacing manual processes with scalable technology, improving data and classification accuracy, and strengthening controls across reporting, fees, registrations, and compliance monitoring. -Develop new circular-economy capabilities and services across recycling, recovery, reverse logistics, and producer accountability, identifying opportunities where Amazon can meet regulatory requirements while improving customer and Selling Partner experiences. -Influence and align senior cross-functional leaders across engineering, science, finance, legal, public policy, operations, and sustainability to resolve ambiguous problems, make investment tradeoffs, and deliver durable global solutions.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: Our team owns the partner onboarding and experience domain within PayPal’s Payment Services & Crypto Engineering organization. We build and operate the platforms that bring merchants and partners onto PayPal and serve them across their entire lifecycle — from first sign-up through the day-to-day work of running their business. Merchant onboarding is one of the most complex problems at PayPal. It spans 200+ markets, 15 banking licenses, 40+ products, and more than 200,000 combinations of country, product, license, and data-field requirements — each with local risk, compliance, tax, and legal nuances. Our mission is to make that complexity invisible: to merchants, to partners, and to the engineers who build on our platform. Job Description: Essential Responsibilities: Implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), receiving structure and oversight from more experienced staff Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions May contribute to code & design reviews Minimum Qualifications: 1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications : What We Build Enhanced Onboarding Platform A next-generation platform that consolidates every onboarding path — direct/organic, connected-path (Integrated Signup), and managed-path (Multi-Account Management) — onto a single, consistent set of rails. EOP replaces flow-by-flow, hard-wired experiences with dynamic, just-in-time UI driven by downstream risk and compliance requirements. Business logic is centralized in a server-side orchestration mid-tier (Merchant Onboarding Management), keeping front-end experiences lightweight. The platform supports web, mobile, API, and webhook integration models and integrates in real time with the Salesforce CRM platform to onboard high-value merchants and partners. Merchant Servicing Platform The platform that supports merchants once they are live — wallet, profile, settings, preferences, configuration, and transaction history. We are extending servicing beyond the UI to offer APIs and webhooks as first-class servicing experiences, especially for partners managing merchants on their own platforms, across all merchant segments from SMB through Large Enterprise. Role Summary We are looking for a Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience to help design, build, and scale the microservices, APIs, and data pipelines behind our onboarding and servicing platforms. You will write high-quality Java code, build resilient RESTful services and batch workflows on the Spring ecosystem, and a decent front-end foundation who is equally comfortable building rich, dynamic user experiences and the services behind them. You will craft the customer-facing web experiences that power merchant and partner onboarding and servicing, and work down the stack into the microservices, APIs, and batch workflows that drive them, This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys owning a feature end to end — from UI to API to data — and collaborate with product and cross-functional partners to deliver features that thousands of merchants and partners depend on every day. Key Responsibilities Software Development (Back-End) Write and maintain clean, efficient, and scalable code primarily in Java and Scala for data pipelines and microservices. Implement microservices architecture, ensuring modularity, scalability, and maintainability. Conduct rigorous code reviews and debugging, and develop automated tests to verify software functionality and performance. Develop and maintain RESTful APIs, Java services, and batch processing jobs using the Spring Framework (including Spring MVC and Spring Boot/Batch where applicable) to support scalable enterprise applications. Front-End Development Build responsive, accessible, and performant web experiences for merchant and partner onboarding and servicing, using modern JavaScript/TypeScript and component-based frameworks (e.g., React). Develop dynamic, data-driven UIs that render just-in-time based on downstream risk, compliance, and product requirements, keeping the front-end lightweight and free of business logic. Optimize front-end performance (load time, rendering, customer-perceived latency) and ensure cross-browser and cross-device consistency, including mobile web. Build against and help shape RESTful APIs and webhooks, handling asynchronous updates and real-time data exchange in the UI. Collaboration and Integration Participate actively in agile development processes, including code reviews, daily stand-ups, and design discussions. Adhere to software engineering best practices such as version control and continuous integration/deployment. Skills and Qualifications Back-End & Technical Skills Proficient in the Java programming language with a solid grasp of software development principles. Familiarity with core computer science concepts such as data structures, algorithms, software design principles, object-oriented programming, and relational database concepts. Knowledge of building and optimizing data storage solutions and managing cloud infrastructure for high availability and performance. Proficient in Java and the Spring ecosystem, with experience building REST APIs, web services, scalable microservices, and batch workflows. Familiarity with programming for data processing and automation to complement Java-based Spring applications. Familiarity with developing automated tests to ensure software functionality and performance. Ability to design, develop, and manage automated workflows for seamless data orchestration. Front-End Skills Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript, with hands-on experience building single-page applications using a component-based framework such as React (Angular or Vue also considered). Experience building responsive, accessible (WCAG-aware) UIs and consuming RESTful APIs and webhooks from the front end. Familiarity with front-end build tooling, testing frameworks, and working within a shared design system or component library. Analytical and Collaboration Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. Effective communication and collaboration abilities to work with cross-functional teams, including product teams. Why Join Us You will build distributed systems with real scale and real stakes — orchestration across PayPal’s core platforms (risk, compliance, identity, and growth), event-driven and batch processing, and API and webhook design. You will see first-hand how strong architecture reduces time-to-market, cuts defects, and improves developer productivity, working alongside engineers and product partners who care deeply about building reusable platform rails rather than one-off flows. Subsidiary: PayPal Travel Percent: 0 PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us . For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations. Our Benefits: At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health. Who We Are: Click Here to learn more about our culture and community. Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com . Belonging at PayPal: Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal. jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced Machine Shop Engineer to own and operate the rapid prototyping shop at our Boston Development Center. As the leader for precision fabrication and additive manufacturing, you own end-to-end execution of machined and 3D-printed components that drive our hardware development. This is a prototype shop: short-run, high-mix. Most jobs are unique, every setup matters, and the engineering team's development velocity depends on what leaves the shop each week. You will manage the full scope of shop operations, multi-axis CNC milling and turning, manual/conventional machining, and industrial 3D printing (metal and polymer). You will hire and develop a team of CNC programmers, precision machinists, and additive manufacturing technicians, set the schedule, and work directly with design and manufacturing engineers to keep first-piece quality high and turnaround tight. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader who came up through programming and machining and is still credible at the CAM seat and on the shop floor. Key job responsibilities - Own day-to-day machine shop operations end-to-end: job scheduling, work prioritization, resource allocation, and throughput management across CNC machining and additive manufacturing equipment. - Hire, develop, and manage a team of CNC machinists, CNC programmers, and additive manufacturing technicians. Set performance expectations, coach development, and hold the team accountable for safety, quality, and delivery. - Manage job queues across multiple concurrent engineering programs, prioritize work to maximize throughput and minimize lead time, balancing urgent R&D prototype requests with operational tooling and fixture needs. Implement job routing and tracking workflows to manage the high-mix, rapid-turnaround queue. - Work directly with product design and manufacturing engineers to review part designs, advise on manufacturability (DFM), select machining strategies, and ensure first-piece quality meets drawing requirements. - Oversee CNC programming (CAM), setup verification, first-piece inspection, in-process checks, tool offsets, and changeovers. Troubleshoot machining issues related to programming, tooling, workholding, dimensional variation, and surface finish. - Manage 3D printing / additive manufacturing operations, job scheduling, material management, build parameter optimization, and post-processing for both metal and polymer systems. - Drive performance metrics: on-time delivery, first-piece quality, throughput, machine utilization, scrap rate. Use data to identify improvement opportunities and report shop performance to leadership. - Ensure safety and housekeeping standards are maintained, 5S, PPE compliance, machine guarding, and EHS requirements for a machining and additive manufacturing environment. - Own equipment maintenance, calibration, and uptime. Evaluate and recommend capital expenditure for new machines, tooling, fixtures, and measurement equipment as the shop scales.

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
팀 소개
쿠팡 Privacy Business팀은 쿠팡의 각종 비즈니스와 운영과 관련하여 발생할 수 있는 개인정보보호 리스크를 관리 감독하는 역할을 수행하는 부서입니다. 개인정보보호법, 위치정보보호법, 정보통신망법 등에서 요구하는 개인정보보호 관련 의무 이행을 준수하기 위해 쿠팡 내부의 구체적인 기준과 이를 위한 업무 프로세스를 제시하는 역할을 수행하고 있습니다. 쿠팡 Privacy Business팀은 지속적으로 이러한 역할을 충실히 수행할 수 있는 각계의 전문가가 함께 하기를 바랍니다.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
The Consumer Apps Desktop team owns the Windows and macOS foundation behind every Roblox session on a PC or Mac: the window, the launch path, and the shell that holds everything together. You will own that foundation with us. We are dedicated to delivering superior performance, reliability, and user experience on Windows and Macs. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Desktop team, you'll be a driving technical force; you will lead complex client work end-to-end and raise the quality bar across our codebase. You will lead projects at that scale end-to-end, set the technical standard in a codebase millions of people depend on daily, and partner with product, design, and platform teams to ship work that is polished and fast at scale.

Shape & improve the Windows and macOS experience that millions of players see every day.
Own major Windows and MacOS initiatives end-to-end from ambiguous idea to shipped, measured, and iterated on.
Rebuild the parts of the app every player touches: how it launches, how it renders, how it lives in the OS.
Set the technical standard through code review, mentorship, and the code you write yourself.
Make platform bets that pay off for engineering teams beyond Desktop.
Translate ambiguous product ideas into well-scoped, high-quality engineering plans in close partnership with product, design, and data science.
Work with our Microsoft and Apple counterparts to ensure feature ubiquity and platform-specific feature excellence.

5+ years shipping client software, with deep C++ expertise, including the ability to work effectively inside a large, established codebase. Experience with Lua/React is a plus.
Released significant Windows or macOS applications. You know the platforms and their APIs throughout.
Debugging and profiling skills that hold up under pressure: tracing, root-causing crashes, and diagnosing performance problems across the full client stack and an enormous range of consumer hardware.
Fluency with concurrency and memory. Threading models and memory footprint are a must have to excel here.
A reflex for data. Metrics, logging, and experiments are how you find out whether a feature works, not how you justify it afterward.
The ability to take an ambiguous problem, break it down, and drive it to done. You communicate clearly, build trust across functions, and make the engineers around you better.
